example_prompt: Check the status, price and courier of a Yango Delivery claim, and wait until it is ready to be confirmed.

claim_id.description: Claim ID received at the claim creation stage Passed as a query parameter.

created_ts.description: Date and time of claim creation

id.description: Claim ID obtained at the claim creation stage

cost_currency.description: Three-digit code of the payment currency

cost_value.description: Price per item in cost_currency. To insure the cost, enter the actual cargo price

droppof_point.description: ID of the point (int64) to deliver the item to. Differs from the ID in the claim. It can be any number. Must match the route_points[].point_id value of the destination point

pickup_point.description: ID of the point (int64) to pick up the item from. Differs from the ID in the claim. It can be any number. Must match the route_points[].point_id value of the dispatch point

extra_id.description: Short unique item ID (order number in the claim, usually identical to external_order_id)

article.description: Item SKU. Must be unique for items delivered from one point.

item_type.description: Name type: product or service. Default value: product

code.description: Unit marking code in accordance with the format 'kind'

kind.description: Marking type. Possible values: 1. compiled — disassembled stamp with dedicated GTIN and Serial. Example: - 444D00000000003741 2. gs1_data_matrix_base64 — unit code in GS1 Data Matrix format subject to marking using identification. Maximum 200 characters. The unit code must be entered in full by encoding the string in base64 format.

mark.description: Unique item code (control identification sign). Valid for Russia. If items have a unique code, a separate block must be created for each of them

supplier_inn.description: Supplier's ITN (10 or 12 digits). Fill in the field for orders with buyout and CoD options. If there is no ITN, specify the default value: 1234567890

vat_code_str.description: VAT rate. Possible values: vat_none — without VAT. vat0 — 0% VAT (applied in rare cases). vat10 — 10% VAT. vat20 — 20% VAT.

fiscalization.description: Fiscalization information (valid for payment upon receipt)

size.description: Unit dimensions in meters. The actual values should be added to the fields. If the dimensions aren't added, the order is placed, taking into account the maximum dimensions allowed for the selected rate. If the actual characteristics of the unit exceed the allowed dimensions, the courier has the right to refuse to fulfill the order on site. In this case, the minimum fee will be withheld. Courier: up to 0.80 m × 0.50 m × 0.50 м Express: up to 1.00 m × 0.60 m × 0.50 m Cargo: - Small body: up to 1.70 m × 0.96 m × 0.90 m - Medium body: up to 2.60 m × 1.30 m × 1.50 m - Large body: up to 3.80 m × 1.80 m × 1.80 m

weight.description: Item weight in kg. The actual values should be entered in the field. If the weight isn't added, the order is placed, taking into account the maximum dimensions allowed for the selected rate. If the actual characteristics of the parcel exceed the allowed dimensions, the courier has the right to refuse to fulfill the order on site. In this case, the minimum fee will be withheld. Courier: up to 10 kg Express: up to 20 kg Cargo: - Small body: up to 300 kg - Medium body: up to 700 kg - Large body: up to 1400 kg

fullname.description: Full address with an indication of the city, street, and house number. You don't need to specify the flat, the entrance number, or the floor.

comment.description: Comment for the courier. For the dispatch point, use the template: "Delivery from store <>. Inform the manager that the order is for Yango Delivery. Provide your order number <> and collect the parcel. The order was paid using cashless payment. So, there's no need to ask the recipient to pay for the delivery when handing over the order." For delivery points, leave the recipient's wishes in the comments. For example, "the intercom doesn't work" / "the gate is closed, call 10 minutes in advance" / "don't call, the baby is asleep".

coordinates.description: Coordinates of points in the form of an array of two real numbers: longitude and latitude — exactly in that order. Rounded coordinate values are specified.

description.description: A geographic area that turns a short address into a global match

shortname.description: Short address within the city (like on a Taximeter)

uri.description: URI of the geo object on maps

phone.description: Phone number of the contact person

email.description: Email is a mandatory parameter for source and return points

phone_additional_code.description: Extension number to call the courier

type.description: Point type: - source: the point of departure where the courier picks up the item - destination: destination points where the courier delivers the items - return: item return point (added automatically and matches the point of departure by default, but a different point can also be selected)

visit_order.description: The order in which the points are visited (numbering starts with 1) (int64)

visit_status.description: Point visit status: - pending — not yet visited. - arrived — the courier arrived at the point. - visited — the courier handed over/picked up the cargo at the point. - skipped — skipped (if the item wasn't accepted).

actual.description: Actual point visit time. Filled in only for visited points.

expected.description: Estimated time of arrival. Can be filled in only for unvisited points.

expected_waiting_time_sec.description: Estimated waiting time at the point. (int64)

visited_at.description: Information about the point visit time

expected_visit_interval.description: Time interval of the courier's visit to the point according to the selected offer

external_order_cost.description: Cost of the external order linked to the point

external_order_id.description: Order number from the customer's system. Entered for destination points

leave_under_door.description: Leave the parcel at the door

meet_outside.description: The courier will be met outside, at the entrance

email.description: User's email address. If not specified, the recipient's email address from the destination point will be used

full_name.description: For legal entities — organization name, for individual entrepreneurs and individuals — full name

phone.description: User's phone number in +X XXX XXX XX XX format. If not specified, the recipient's phone number from the destination point will be used

payment_method.description: Selected payment method. card — payment by card. cash — cash payment (not yet available).

pickup_code.description: Parcel pick-up code. The courier needs to enter this code to confirm that they have picked up the parcel. This requires your employees to be at the point of dispatch to provide this code to the courier. Relevant for source points. Code format: 6 digits Item pick-up code (pick-up point)

return_comment.description: Comments on the reasons for returning the cargo

skip_confirmation.description: Skip SMS confirmation at the given point Default value: false (confirmation required).

route_points.description: Route point information Route point information

status.description: Claim status. To learn more, see Status model (https://yango-delivery.viewer.diplodoc.yandex.ru/en/api/express/claim-process.md)

updated_ts.description: Date and time of the last claim update

user_request_revision.description: The current version of changes in the claim entered by the user

callback_url.description: The URL used in the case of a status change for the claim. This mechanism is deprecated, use the claims/journal (https://yango-delivery.viewer.diplodoc.yandex.ru/en/api/express/openapi/IntegrationV2ClaimsJournal.md) operation instead.

callback_properties.description: Parameters for notifying the client's server about the claim status change. A notification is a POST request to the specified URL to which information about the date of the last claim change and claim ID in the format 'updated_ts=<ISO-8601>&claim_id=<claim id>' will be added. Which means that this URL 'https://example.com/?my_order_id=123&' format will be expanded into 'https://example.com/?my_order_id=123&updated_ts=...&claim_id=...'. Note that parameters are added by concatenation to callback_url, which means that the URL such as 'https://example.com' will turn into this invalid format: 'https://example.comupdated_ts=...&claim_id=...'. Only HTTP and HTTPS are supported. In the case of HTTPS, an SSL certificate must be issued by a certification authority known to the server. Notifications should be viewed as a push ahead of polling, a way of speeding up information on status changes. The server expects the 200 response, and if there are timeouts or any other response, it will attempt to deliver the notification and then stop the attempts. So in order to reliably obtain the claim status, the client needs to request information using the method claims/info (https://yango-delivery.viewer.diplodoc.yandex.ru/en/api/express/openapi/IntegrationV2ClaimsInfo.md). The client should note that the response of the claims/info (https://yango-delivery.viewer.diplodoc.yandex.ru/en/api/express/openapi/IntegrationV2ClaimsInfo.md) operation may contain an older claim state (the value of the updated_ts field should be used as a reference). In this case, the operation call must be repeated after some time (from 5 to 30 seconds).

taxi_class.description: Delivery rate. Possible values: courier, express, cargo

cargo_loaders.description: Number of loaders for the cargo rate. Possible values: 0, 1, 2. For an exact list of possible values for a particular point, use the method for obtaining rates tariffs (https://yango-delivery.viewer.diplodoc.yandex.ru/en/api/express/openapi/IntegrationV2Tariffs.md).

cargo_options.description: List of additional rate options. Possible separate options: - auto_courier (a courier with a vehicle only) - thermobag (a courier with a thermobag) Example of a list of options: ["auto_courier"]. For an exact list of possible values for a particular geo point, use the method for obtaining rates tariffs (https://yango-delivery.viewer.diplodoc.yandex.ru/en/api/express/openapi/IntegrationV2Tariffs.md)

cargo_type.description: Body type (size) for the cargo rate. Possible values: - van ("Small body") - lcv_m ("Medium body") - lcv_l ("Large body") - lcv_xl ("XL body") For an exact list of possible values for a particular geo point, use the method for obtaining rates tariffs (https://yango-delivery.viewer.diplodoc.yandex.ru/en/api/express/openapi/IntegrationV2Tariffs.md)

pro_courier.description: Enable the "Pro" option for "Express" and "Courier" rates. In this case, we will look only for experienced couriers.

client_requirements.description: Customer requirements specified when creating or editing a claim

corp_client_id.description: Yango Delivery corporate client ID (from the OAuth token)

current_point_id.description: Integer point ID (int64) generated on the Yango Delivery side. It is in the route_points[].id field. Applicable to source, destination, and return points.

due.description: Estimated time of arrival of the courier. If this parameter isn't specified, we will look for a courier as soon as possible.

phone.description: Phone number of the contact person

phone_additional_code.description: Extension number to call the courier

emergency_contact.description: Information about the contact person with a phone number

error_messages.description: List of error messages Error code and description

eta.description: Estimated order fulfillment time in minutes (int64)

taxi_class.description: Delivery rate. Possible values: courier, express, cargo

pro_courier.description: Enable the "Pro" option for "Express" and "Courier" rates. In this case, we will look only for experienced couriers.

optional_return.description: Disable item return in case of order cancellation. Possible values: - true (the courier keeps the item) - false (by default, the item must be returned)

courier_name.description: Name of the courier who is delivering a parcel

legal_name.description: Data on the legal entity that performs the delivery

car_color_hex.description: RGB code of the vehicle color

car_number.description: License plate number of the vehicle

currency.description: Three-digit code of the payment currency

code.description: Three-digit code of the payment currency

valid_until.description: Time until which the offer to accept the claim is valid. If there is no value, there are no limits on the offer duration

offer.description: Offer from Yango Delivery (valid for some time).

route_id.description: ID of the route within which the order is delivered If multiple orders are delivered by one courier, all of them will have the same route_id (Relevant only for the "Same-day delivery")

skip_client_notify.description: Don't send SMS notifications to the sender/recipient when a courier is on their way. Default value: false (send notifications)

skip_door_to_door.description: Disable door-to-door delivery (disable the "Door-to-door" option). Possible values: - true (the courier will deliver the order only at the entrance outside) - false (the courier will deliver the order to the door) - default value

skip_emergency_notify.description: Don't send a notification to the emergency contact person Default value: false (send notifications)

code.description: Warning type: - not_fit_in_car: the cargo may not fit in the vehicle. - requirement_unavailable: the specified requirement isn't available and has been ignored. - address_not_found - the specified address wasn't found in maps. - address_too_far: the coordinates from maps the specified address are far from the transmitted coordinates.

source.description: Warning source: - client_requirements — the warning is related to customer requirements. - route_points — the warning is related to the transmitted addresses.

gotchas: Authenticate with 'Authorization: Bearer <OAuth token>'. The token comes from your Yango Delivery account (log in with the credentials your Yango Delivery manager gives you, Integration tab, Get token). It remains valid indefinitely, but changing the account password invalidates it; an invalid token answers 401 unauthorized.

Key statuses: ready_for_approval (confirm within 10 minutes), estimating_failed (reasons in error_messages; edit the claim to retry), performer_not_found (no courier: create a new claim later), delivered_finish and returned_finish (completed), failed.
The callback section of create_delivery_claim warns that this method may return an older claim state: compare updated_ts with what you already have and call again after 5 to 30 seconds.

Before confirming, read warnings[]: the FAQ says not_fit_in_car can come together with the ready_for_approval status when the items may not fit the vehicle, and check_delivery_price notes that a courier can refuse items exceeding the allowed dimensions on site, with the minimum fee withheld.
If the recipient doesn't answer within 10 minutes of the courier's arrival (delivery_arrived), the items are returned to the sender.
The status model also lists pay_waiting (pending payment, with payment on delivery), which the status enum of this reference leaves out: don't reject an unknown status value.
version is the claim's current version: accept_delivery_claim and cancel_delivery_claim need it.

pricing.offer holds the offer to confirm: price is without VAT, price_with_vat includes it, and valid_until is the offer's expiry. From performer_found on, performer_info describes the courier and vehicle. Finding a courier takes no more than 30 minutes for an immediate claim.
Accept-Language is a required header on this endpoint (e.g. en); this example sends en.

delivery.yango.com lists Côte d'Ivoire, Ghana, Senegal and Zambia under Africa. The Côte d'Ivoire and Senegal pages mention API integrations; the Ghana and Zambia pages say 'integrations' without naming the API. Every example in this reference uses UAE data (AED prices, +971 phone numbers): confirm with your Yango Delivery manager that API access is open in your country.

Errors return { code, message }: branch on code. Documented on this endpoint: 400 bad_request; 404 not_found; 429 too_many_requests. The error guide adds 401 unauthorized (invalid token) and 500 (try again or change the request).
